_configs_note: Snapshot only — not load-bearing. The '-XXXX' suffixes are account-specific and regenerated on each setup-evaluations.sh run; consumers read evalConfigName from agents.json, which refresh-agents-json.sh repopulates by querying live CW log groups. Keys use the canonical long form 'eval_<agentId>' (e.g. eval_agentcore_hub_requirements_analyst), matching what setup-evaluations.sh creates.
_reapply_note: Live configs carry the 10-evaluator matrix. Sampling tiers (TEAM-3376) are still encoded in setup-evaluations.sh for NEW configs only; existing configs are skipped on re-run and keep their own rule.

notes.coding_runtime_configs: TEAM-4688: the coding-runtime configs (agentcore_hub_coding_runtime and its _ec2 twin) have no supported span scopes → 100 % ValidationException; DISABLED not deleted. The judge is turned off with PUT /api/evaluations/agents/agentcore_hub_coding_runtime {enabled:false} (flips executionStatus to DISABLED); the config and its results log group stay, so history and the reconcile in lambda/eval-packager keep working.

notes.dependency_chain_agents: TEAM-3368: only requirements_analyst has the custom evaluator — it is the only role that CREATES the ticket dependency graph; qa_verifier/ci_agent reassign rather than construct chains and scored rubric-mismatch zeros. In the 1-runtime topology the shared runtime carries it too (it hosts requirements_analyst; the eval-packager's role guard drops dependency-chain rows for every other persona). Every other config gets Builtin.Conciseness in the tenth slot. (Historical: the reverted TEAM-3376 5-evaluator shape put Builtin.Helpfulness in a fifth slot.)
notes.sampling: Tiered sampling keeps the Opus judge under its RPM quota. If throttling persists anyway, see 'Eval judge throttling (quota)' in docs/orchestration-tracing-guide.md for the operator quota-increase runbook.
notes.monitoring_region: eval-success-rate-alarm.json and eval-health-dashboard.json hard-code us-east-1 (pure JSON can't carry comments); substitute the region at apply time — see the monitoring comment blocks in setup-evaluations.sh.
notes.max_evaluators: API limit is 10 evaluators per config and the matrix uses all 10. Historical: TEAM-3366 §2.4 trimmed to 5 to cut Opus-judge load; that trim was never operator-approved and was reverted 2026-09-15.
